title: A discharged gun captain
text: A boat pulls alongside with one passenger: a grey-haired gun captain, paid off from the Navy with nothing but his drill book and a grudge. He'll teach your gun crews for a price.

choices.text: Pay him to sign on (40 gold)

outcomes.text: By sunset he has the gun crews running out and in like clockwork, and cursing them like the King's own.
He spits over the side and rows off towards the next sail.

title: A cook in a hen coop
text: Floating in a hen coop among the wreckage of a packet ship: a furious Frenchman clutching a copper pan, and two very wet chickens.

outcomes.text: He takes one look at the galley, swears in three languages, and that night the crew eat like admirals.
He's grateful, but the moment you touch land he's gone, and so are two casks of rum.

choices.text: Take the chickens, leave the Frenchman

outcomes.text: Fresh eggs for a week. The crew don't look you in the eye.

title: A whaler stove in
text: A Nantucket whaler, her bow stove in by a bull whale, settling by the head. Her crew are in the boats, and one old harpooner won't let go of his iron.

outcomes.text: "I'll pay my passage in oil," he says, and sets about rigging a lookout in your foretop.

choices.text: Strip her of oil before she goes down

outcomes.text: You get a dozen casks out before she slides under.

title: A natural philosopher
text: A small island, a smoking hut, and a man with no eyebrows waving a flag made from his own coat. He wants passage, and he promises to make your guns "interesting".

choices.text: Give him passage and the run of the magazine

outcomes.text: He sets to work on your round shot with a file, a funnel and an alarming grin.
His first 'improvement' goes off on deck. He survives, and so does his box of tricks.
As you sail off, the hut explodes. A cheer comes faintly over the water.

title: A chandler's lighter
text: A low lighter hails you, her deck crowded with crates and odd characters. "Something for every ship, captain. No questions, no refunds."

outcomes.text: You point at a crate, and what comes out is better than you hoped.
She drifts away towards the next sail.
